name: Chloral hydrate
summary: Chloral Hydrate, a sedative drug discovered in 1832 with a history of recreational use going back to the 19th century. The drug is prescribed rarely for extreme insomnia. There is limited information on the drug's long-term effects on the body. The drug is reported to induce a intoxication comparable to alcohol or benzodiazepines.
